notes: The two good-clauses split differently and correctly: τοῦ takes that which under rule 22, while ὁ takes the single relativizer who under rule 31's verbless-modifier branch (rule 90 is cited but is scoped to a participle), and each adjective keeps its own supplied copula under rule 53.
εἰσελθεῖν keeps only enter, the expressed εἰς answering to the preverb (rule 106); τήν before life is unrepresented, the ASV writing no determiner.
